byteIdentity.dryHalfOfHalfWetScene: byte-exact vs mode-off on both the renderScene shell and the live presentProbe shell
byteIdentity.modeOnAllZeroMaskVsModeOff: byte-identical (f = 0 everywhere returns the dry composite untouched)
byteIdentity.modeOnNoFieldVsModeOff: byte-identical (soak uniforms bound off, dummy textures)

exportParity.shedAnswer: perfTier1 shed serve (degradedOk false): mask absent → static blend everywhere; the stratum row's WET indicator dims (LayerStack wet-dim rule)
exportParity.warmUpExport: flagged scene exports through the K=90 warm-up with readout 'wet: warm-up K=90'; two runs byte-identical; flagged differs from unflagged by > 50 pixels

harness: app/src/gl/wetSoak.selfcheck.mjs — GL sections drive the real renderer through the parity harness (glDriver) plus exportStill; all numbers below were measured in that suite or in one-off probes against the same harness during development
observations: Pre-existing, not from this slice: the live shell (presentProbe) and the offline shell (renderScene) already differ on a BONE-DRY scene (max delta 223, mean delta 2.83) in this sandbox — likely live-shell resolve-option defaults. Parity for this slice is therefore asserted within each shell (candidate vs chunked export; live vs live), where it is byte-exact.

termA_absorption.groundFallback: no pigment pack: absorption equals the ground colour (frame background) alone, same method
termA_absorption.method: coverage measured from a black/white render pair (a = 1 - (white-black)/255); pixels with a > 0.97 and dry channel > 100; median of soaked/dry per channel

termB_smear.method: one isolated mark (pxg_diamond, scene 500,350, scale 6) on white; dark edges (lum < 200) on its darkest row; velocity pack at full deflection, both signs
termB_smear.reading: one-sided trailing smear: the leading edge never moves, the trailing edge extends 6px WITH the flow; the sign of the shift follows the velocity sign

termC_stamping.serviceProbe: a soak-only consumer (no ACCUM) births the field through the wet-frame gate; after 30 frames at wetness 0.8 a resting stratum's mark leaves mask > 0.05 at its cell and pigStep advances
termC_stamping.shapingHalf: vacuous antecedent — samplePattern's only consumer is the PATTERN tile engine; no content layout sampler calls it (verified by grep). Documented in docs/WET_ENGINE.md and the staging report; the binding point (emitFromInstances stamp) is named there.
